in `Iterator` and `DoubleEndedIterator` impls for `glib::VariantStrIter`","description":"The `VariantStrIter::impl_get` function (called internally by implementations of the `Iterator` and `DoubleEndedIterator` traits for this type) was unsound, resulting in undefined behaviour.

An immutable reference `&p` to a `*mut libc::c_char` pointer initialized to `NULL` was passed as an argument to a C function that that mutates the pointer behind `&p` in-place (i.e. as an out-argument), which was unsound. After changes in recent versions of the Rust compiler, these unsound writes through `&p` now seem to be completely disregarded when building the `glib` crate with optimizations.

This subsequently caused all calls of `VariantStrIter::impl_get` to violate the safety requirements of the `std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr` function - which requires its argument to be a valid pointer to a C-style string - resulting in crashes due to `NULL` pointer dereferences.

This was fixed by passing the out-argument pointer explitly as `&mut p` instead of `&p`.

This issue has been present since this code was initially added in `glib` v0.15.0. The mismatch in mutability was likely missed (and not raised as an error by the compiler) because the C function wrapped by `VariantStrIter::impl_get` is variadic (`glib_sys::g_variant_get_child`), and the pointer in question is one of the variadic arguments.","date":"2024-03-30","aliases":["GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g"],"related":[],"collection":"crates","categories":[],"keywords":[],"cvss":null,"informational":"unsound","references":[],"source":null,"url":"https://github.com/gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core/pull/1343","withdrawn":null,"license":"CC0-1.0","expect-deleted":false},"affected":{"arch":[],"os":[],"functions":{"glib::VariantStrIter::last":[">=0.15.0, <0.20.0"],"glib::VariantStrIter::next":[">=0.15.0, <0.20.0"],"glib::VariantStrIter::next_back":[">=0.15.0, <0.20.0"],"glib::VariantStrIter::nth":[">=0.15.0, <0.20.0"],"glib::VariantStrIter::nth_back":[">=0.15.0, <0.20.0"]}},"versions":{"patched":[">=0.20.0"],"unaffected":["<0.15.0"]}}],"yanked":[{"kind":"yanked","package":{"name":"clipboard-win","version":"5.4.1","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index","checksum":"bde03770d3df201d4fb868f2c9c59e66a3e4e2bd06692a0fe701e7103c7e84d4","dependencies":[{"name":"error-code","version":"3.3.2","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"}],"replace":null},"advisory":null,"affected":null,"versions":null},{"kind":"yanked","package":{"name":"uds_windows","version":"1.2.0","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index","checksum":"51b70b87d15e91f553711b40df3048faf27a7a04e01e0ddc0cf9309f0af7c2ca","dependencies":[{"name":"memoffset","version":"0.9.1","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"},{"name":"tempfile","version":"3.26.0","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"},{"name":"windows-sys","version":"0.61.2","source":"registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"}],"replace":null},"advisory":null,"affected":null,"versions":null}]}}
